resolution.question: The Marlin Bay harbor advisory committee needs five of its nine members present to act. Will it reach quorum at its rescheduled Tuesday evening meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if at least five members (including the chair) are physically present at the meeting location at the scheduled start time or within a reasonable grace period (e.g., 15 minutes). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
